needFrom: Pick your starting point from the list.
needTo: Pick where you're going from the list.
same: Start and destination are the same place. Pick a different one.

timePicker.invalid: That time isn't valid. Type 24-hour time, e.g. 0930 or 18:45.

locateError.unavailable: Couldn't find you. Check your GPS and connection and try again, or type a place.
